prose:
Google says Gemini Notebook can generate interactive sites from a user’s sources and make the result available in a separate tab or through sharing. The short announcement describes a web rollout for users aged 18 and over, including Workspace subscribers, with mobile support planned later.

The retrieved text offers little detail on access controls, source fidelity or generated-code behavior. Creating an interactive presentation does not verify every claim drawn from its sources, and a rollout announcement does not establish access for every account immediately.
highlights: Feature turns sources into an interactive site
Mobile availability is stated as forthcoming
Generated presentation does not validate source claims
Sharing and fidelity details were not fully available
